description: Items that share the same Name but have different gameIds and sprites. Maps fully-qualified gameIds to unique IDs and icon filenames. Only needed when DisplayName extraction doesn't provide correct sprite name.

(O)113.name: Chicken Statue (Artifact)
(O)113.notes: Donatable artifact dug up from artifact spots; shares the name 'Chicken Statue' with the big-craftable (BC)31 and furniture variants

(T)Pan.name: Copper Pan
(T)Pan.notes: Tool entity for the Copper Pan. The pan also has a Hats.json entry (worn visually) that collides on kebab-id 'copper-pan'; this variant gives the tool form a distinct id so both survive the merge. Save files reference this as itemId='Pan' under xsi:type='Pan'.

(T)SteelPan.name: Steel Pan
(T)SteelPan.notes: Tool entity for the Steel Pan; see (T)Pan note. Save files use itemId='SteelPan' under xsi:type='Pan'.

(T)GoldPan.name: Gold Pan
(T)GoldPan.notes: Tool entity for the Gold Pan; see (T)Pan note. Save files use itemId='GoldPan' under xsi:type='Pan'.

(T)IridiumPan.name: Iridium Pan
(T)IridiumPan.notes: Tool entity for the Iridium Pan; see (T)Pan note. Save files use itemId='IridiumPan' under xsi:type='Pan'.

(O)126.name: Strange Doll (Green)
(O)126.notes: Green-colored Strange Doll artifact; shares display name with (O)127 — disambiguated by color_green context tag

(O)127.name: Strange Doll (Yellow)
(O)127.notes: Yellow-colored Strange Doll artifact; shares display name with (O)126 — disambiguated by color_yellow context tag
